text:
zara: Quick doc thread  I'm finishing the audit-exports page. Need review for SOC2-safe wording, an SDK migration note, and a small Console anchor fix. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1526
kevin: Paste the examples you plan to include so we can sanity-check placeholders and PII risks.
zara: REST curl example (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit-exports\" \\\\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>\" \\\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\\n  -d '{"filter":{"start":"2024-03-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2024-03-31T23:59:59Z"},"destination":{"type":"s3","bucket":"<S3_BUCKET>"}}'
```
kevin: Good. SDK snippet?
zara: JS snippet and short migration line:
```js
// old: client.audit.exportLogs({from, to})
// new:
const job = await client.audit.startExport({
  filter: {start: '2024-03-01T00:00:00Z', end: '2024-03-31T23:59:59Z'},
  destination: {type: 's3', bucket: '<S3_BUCKET>'}
});
console.log(job.id);
```
Short migration note: \"If you previously used client.audit.exportLogs(), update to client.audit.startExport() and add a destination object (S3/GCS).\"
michael: Change bucket placeholder to <YOUR_BUCKET> and add RBAC note: only org admins/org owners may create exports. Also add a one-line UTC note: \"All sample timestamps are in UTC (Z).\"
compliance-bot: Reminder: public docs must not include real emails, IPs, SSNs, or credential examples. Use masked/internal ids. Also recommend a short SOC2-safe callout: \"Audit logs record security events and use internal identifiers; exports do not include raw PII by default.\"
zara: Will add the RBAC line, UTC note, and SOC2 callout. Also discovered a broken anchor: docs link pointed to /console/audit#exporting but current site uses /console/audit#exports  I'll update the link and add a small redirect note: \"Old bookmarks should redirect, update if possible.\"
kevin: One more helpful addition: add a one-line pointer to retention docs and note that retention policy changes are recorded as policy.update events in the audit log for auditability.
zara: Great, I'll push the updated commit with placeholders fixed, RBAC sentence, SOC2-safe callout, UTC note, anchor fix, and retention pointer. I'll ping when done.
compliance-bot: Pre-merge checklist: PR 1526 will be scanned for PII and anchor validity on push.
